dialogues.speaker: Eloffe
dialogues.text: Welcome to Chioriya Boutique. Is there anything you need?

dialogues.speaker: Eloffe
dialogues.text: This clothes shop was opened by Ms. Chiori, a renowned Inazuman designer.

dialogues.speaker: Eloffe
dialogues.text: She has gained great favor in Fontaine's fashion world by incorporating elements of "resistance" and "revolution" into her designs.

dialogues.speaker: Eloffe
dialogues.text: I know this sounds like tooting one's own horn, but it is no exaggeration to say that Ms. Chiori has sparked a real fashion craze here in our nation.

dialogues.speaker: Eloffe
dialogues.text: I'm Eloffe, a staff member here at the boutique. I'm in charge of taking pre-orders and receiving clients... and placating them, at times.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't really need anything at the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Eloffe
dialogues.text: I look forward to your next visit.

dialogues.speaker: Eloffe
dialogues.text: Our boss's manner of speech is... on the straightforward side. Takes some getting used to, if you catch my drift.

dialogues.speaker: Eloffe
dialogues.text: But not to worry. Chioriya Boutique's work is always up to standard.

dialogues.speaker: Eloffe
dialogues.text: This is why some customers might leave in a huff, but they'll be back in a few days to commission clothes all the same.

dialogues.speaker: Eloffe
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you. Welcome. What can I do for you today?

dialogues.speaker: Eloffe
dialogues.text: Thanks to you, Ms. Chiori's fashion show was a smash hit.

dialogues.speaker: Eloffe
dialogues.text: Since then, we've launched a large number of new products, and customers have been pouring in like a waterfall. If anything, we haven't got enough manpower to handle it all.

dialogues.speaker: Eloffe
dialogues.text: Ms. Chiori has even mentioned that she'd like to go on a trip with you sometime.

dialogues.speaker: Eloffe
dialogues.text: Ah, but be sure not to tell her that I was the one who told you.
